title: Teamlead Performance Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Als Teamlead Performance Marketing (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für unsere bezahlten Wachstumskanäle – Native, SEA und Paid Social. Du führst ein Team von mehreren Media Buyern, berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth und arbeitest eng mit dem Founder-Team zusammen

Native Advertising ist dabei unser umsatzstärkster Performance-Kanal und der Schwerpunkt der Rolle: Hier liegt die Verantwortung end-to-end bei Dir und Deinem Team, von der Ideenfindung über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Testing und Optimierung. Gleichzeitig entwickelst Du das Kanal-Portfolio weiter, über Native, SEA und Paid Social hinaus.

Aufgaben

  • Channel-Verantwortung: Du verantwortest Budget, Performance und Steuerung über Native, SEA und Paid Social hinweg.
  • Native Advertising als Kern: Du treibst unseren stärksten Performance-Kanal end-to-end: Ideenfindung, Konzeption, Umsetzung, Testing, Optimierung – und den Test weiterer Native-Plattformen.
  • Direct Response: Du denkst in Advertorials, Landingpages und Angebotslogik. Du weißt, welche Mechanismen Menschen zum Kauf bewegen, und baust daraus systematisch Funnels und Tests.
  • Führung & Teamentwicklung: Du führst vier Media Buyer fachlich und disziplinarisch, entwickelst sie weiter und stellst fachliche Qualität sicher, ohne alles selbst zu bauen.
  • Agentur- & Freelancer-Steuerung: Du steuerst unsere Google- und Meta-Agentur sowie externe Native-Ressourcen ergebnisorientiert – inklusive Briefing, Zielsetzung und Qualitätssicherung.
  • Weitere Kanäle & Ausbau: Neben Native, SEA und Paid Social liegen weitere Kanäle wie z.B. unser Upsell-Programm oder Retargeting in Deinem Scope. Du baust dieses Portfolio aktiv aus.
  • Attribution & Profitabilität: Du arbeitest mit unserer cross-channel Attribution, verstehst den Unterschied zwischen ROAS und POAS – und triffst Budgetentscheidungen entsprechend.
  • Data & Analytics: Du analysierst Performance-Daten anhand relevanter Metriken (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS/POAS, Conversion Rate, AoV) und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Testing & Skalierung: Du verantwortest A/B-Tests und Skalierungs-Strategien, um Channels, Kampagnen und Funnels messbar zu verbessern.
  • Creative-Sparring: Du gibst datenbasiertes Feedback und arbeitest eng mit Creative Strategy, Copywriting und Grafik – was performt, was nicht, und warum.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Native Advertising (u.a. Outbrain, Taboola)
  • Nachgewiesene Führungserfahrung – Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und entwickelt
  • Sehr gutes Direct-Response-Wissen: Advertorials, Landingpages, Angebotslogik, Funnel-Logiken
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Paid Social (insbesondere Meta). In SEA und Google Demand Gen brauchst Du keine Hands-on-Expertise, Du musst sie aber fachlich führen und beurteilen können.
  • Du denkst in Creative Angles, nicht nur Kennzahlen: Aus Performance-Daten leitest du konkrete Hypothesen für neue Hooks, Formate und Advertorial-Ansätze ab
  • Hintergrund im E-Commerce- bzw. D2C-Umfeld in Beauty oder Health
  • Du liebst Zahlen und hast eine analytische, strukturierte Denkweise
  • Bid-Strategien und eine effiziente Budgetsteuerung über mehrere Kanäle sind für Dich kein Problem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Agenturen und Freelancern
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark, verhandlungssicher und arbeitest selbstständig
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit Tracking- und Attributionstools (z.B. GA4, Admetrics)
  • Verständnis dafür, dass Paid-Kanäle über den eigenen Shop hinaus wirken (z.B. auf Amazon), und dass solche Effekte über Korrelation und Inkrementalitätstests beurteilt werden.
  • Erfahrung mit weiteren Kanälen wie Criteo oder Upsell-Tools
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder Inhousing von Kanälen

Benefits

  • Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem schnell wachsenden Health / Food Scale-up
  • kollegiale Zusammenarbeit in gutem Betriebsklima
  • flache Hierarchien
  • faire Vergütung
  • betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • abwechslungsreiche und interessante Tätigkeit
  • Scale-up Flair: Du arbeitest eng mit einem dynamischen und hochmotivierten Team zusammen
  • Partizipationsmöglichkeiten an fachübergreifender Unternehmensentwicklung
  • Mitarbeiter-Veranstaltungen (sofern möglich)
  • Netzwerken auf verschiedenen Events und Termine, u.a. Judith Williams
  • Einstellung ab sofort

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

title: IT Working Student
Praktikum Commercial Operations & Account Management
description:
Praktikum Commercial Operations & Account Management

UNSERE MISSION

Wir wollen die erste Anlaufstelle für den Autowechsel werden. Mit einer Kombination aus Technologie, Medien und tiefem Verständnis für den Automobilsektor haben wir schon jetzt die Art wie Menschen Autos (ver)kaufen, vermarkten und leasen, auf den Kopf gestellt.

Was als einfache Neuwagen-Vergleichsplattform begann, ist heute einer der größten Online-Marktplätze für den Autowechsel in Europa. Im letzten Jahr allein sind wir dabei mit Fahrzeugen, die im Wert von über £3bn über unser Portal gekauft, geleast oder versteigert wurden, um über 50% gewachsen.

2024 haben wir mit der Übernahme von Autovia – der Plattform hinter AutoExpress und dem Evo Magazin – anschließend unsere Reichweite über Nacht verdoppelt. Zusammen zählen wir nun mit fast 10 Mio. Abonnenten und 1,1 Mrd. jährlichen Aufrufen zu den größten YouTube-Kanälen der Welt. Daneben verkaufen wir 1,2 Mio. Kopien unseres Print-Magazins und erreichen jährlich über 350 Mio. Menschen mit unserem Web-Content.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht fertig.

GET YOUR CAR @ CARWOW

Mit unserer Business Unit "Get Your Car" machen wir den Prozess, das nächste Fahrzeug zu finden, so einfach, smart und transparent wie nie zuvor.

Nach unserer erfolgreichen Series-E-Finanzierungsrunde mit über 52 Mio. US-Dollar starten wir jetzt in eine neue Wachstumsphase.

Unser Commercial-Team spielt dabei eine Schlüsselrolle: Wir unterstützen unsere Partnerhändler dabei, ihre Performance auf unserer Plattform zu maximieren und schaffen so echte Mehrwerte auf beiden Seiten - für Käufer:innen und Händler.

Wenn du Lust hast, direkt mit Autohäusern zusammenzuarbeiten und so die Zukunft des Autohandels aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, dann bist du hier genau richtig.

Du wirst Teil eines schlanken, dynamischen Teams, das eng mit unseren Produkt-, Marketing- und Analytics-Teams zusammenarbeiten.


DEINE MISSION

Als Praktikant:in im Bereich Commercial Operations & Account Management arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Partnern zusammen und unterstützt das Team dabei, datengetriebene Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unseren langfristigen Erfolg sichern.

Du lernst, wie wir Partner unterstützen, Prozesse optimieren und mit kreativen Ideen echten Mehrwert schaffen - für Händler, Kund:innen und Carwow gleichermaßen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du arbeitest eng mit allen Teams innerhalb des Commercial-Bereichs zusammen und übernimmst eigenständig Aufgaben (sowohl für Carwow, als auch unsere Partner)

  • Du unterstützt unsere Partnerhändler telefonisch und sorgst dafür, dass sie auf unserer Plattform ein echtes "WoW"-Erlebnis haben

  • Du analysierst Partner-Performance und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab, um ihren Erfolg auf unserer Plattform zu steigern

  • Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in unsere datengetriebenen Systeme und lernst, wie Technologie und Vertrieb bei Carwow ineinandergreifen

  • Du arbeitest an spannenden Projekten mit (inklusive AI-Prozessen) und leistest so einen aktiven Beitrag dazu, Carwow smarter und effizienter zu machen


DAS ZEICHNET DICH AUS

  • Du befindest dich aktuell im Studium und möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen in einem dynamischen, praxisnahen Umfeld anwenden

  • Du brennst für digitale Geschäftsmodelle und fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Zahlen und Daten

  • Dein Interesse an Datenanalyse und digitalen Tools hilft, dich schnell in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten (Erfahrung mit Excel, Google Sheets oder vergleichbaren Tools ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss)

  • Du bringst eine "Can-Do" Mentalität mit, arbeitest gern eigenständig und übernimmst Verantwortung

  • Mit deiner Kommunikationsstärke (auf Deutsch und Englisch) baust du schnell vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf

  • Dank deiner proaktiven Art und Energie gehst du neue Herausforderungen motiviert und lösungsorientiert an

  • Du hast Lust, Carwow für mindestens sechs Monate als Praktikant:in zu unterstützen


UNSER INTERVIEW PROZESS

  • Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 15-20 Minuten

  • Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 45 Minuten

  • Finales Interview (online) mit Head of Department - ca. 45 Minuten

UND WAS SPRINGT FÜR DICH DABEI RAUS?

  • Maximales Lernpotential in einem internationalen Umfeld

  • Start-Up-Vibes mit einer modernen, offenen Unternehmenskultur

title: Laboratory Technician / Operator BTA/CTA – Protein Analytics (all genders)
description:
Role Overview

Help us ensure the quality and reliability behind every protein we bring to life.

As our Laboratory Technician - Protein Analytics, you'll be the hands-on backbone of our analytical lab, running the routine testing that tells us exactly what's happening inside our fermentation-derived proteins. From HPLC-UV runs to sample prep for proteomics and protein assays, your careful, well-documented work gives our scientists the data they need to keep pushing our precision fermentation platform forward.


Location: Frankfurt am Main

.

About Formo

At Formo, we’re rebuilding dairy to help create a just and resilient food system. 

Using precision fermentation, we produce real, bio-identical milk proteins, starting with casein, without the need for animals.

As a B2B ingredient company, we partner with leading food manufacturers to bring next-generation dairy products to market. We focus on developing and scaling high-performance dairy proteins that enable our partners to create exceptional products.

Our work sits at the intersection of molecular biology, food science, and industrial biotechnology. By combining cutting-edge science with deep application expertise, we empower the dairy industry to deliver products that are indulgent, functional, and more sustainable - without compromise.

Formo is a venture-backed, fast-growing company with an international team of entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators united by the ambition to transform dairy from within the industry. Together with our partners, we are shaping a future where animal-free dairy proteins unlock new possibilities for innovation at global scale.


Key Responsibilities

Analytical Testing

  • Perform routine HPLC-UV analyses according to established SOPs

  • Conduct protein assays (e.g. Bradford) and support physicochemical analyses (e.g. particle size determination)

Sample Preparation

  • Prepare samples for proteomics analyses (e.g. protein extraction, digestion, purification)

Documentation & Quality

  • Thoroughly evaluate and document results in accordance with internal guidelines

Instrument Management

  • Operate, clean, calibrate and maintain analytical instruments

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with scientists to support ongoing projects


About You

Education & Experience

  • Completed training as a BTA, CTA or comparable qualification

  • Initial practical laboratory experience (e.g. through training, internships or entry-level work)

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Basic knowledge of HPLC or chromatographic methods is a plus

  • Good documentation skills

  • English proficiency at least B1 level (spoken and written); German is a plus

Mindset & Collaboration 

  • Careful, structured and reliable working style, with high motivation and scientific curiosity to learn new techniques

  • Genuine interest in protein analytics and biochemical methods

  • Team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of responsibility


Why you’ll love it here

Ready to shake things up?

At Formo, you don’t just trade your labor for compensation - you join a mission. One powered by frontier science, real-world impact, and a team of brilliant, driven people who care deeply about what they’re building.

You’ll work side by side with interdisciplinary experts across highly skilled entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators. We believe the best ideas emerge when diverse perspectives collide, and when people are trusted with responsibility, autonomy, and meaningful challenges.

We’re building something ambitious, and we take the work seriously - but not ourselves. Expect close collaboration, fast learning and innovation, and a culture that celebrates progress (often with tastings 🧀).

  • Help reinvent one of the world’s most iconic food categories

You'll be the strategic engine behind our UK and US commercial strategy: turning category, market, retail and DTC data into sharp, real-world calls on portfolio, pricing and promotion. You'll report to our GM of Commercial Strategy + Insight, and work closely with regional retail, DTC, Supply Chain and Finance teams to keep the UK and US businesses growing profitably.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that's why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

You can expect to:

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

What we're looking for

  • At least five (5) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.

  • Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

Our culture

At Synthesia we're passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

The hiring process:

  • 45 min call with the Head of Website about your past projects

  • 75 min practical exercise with one of our engineers. We hand you a real Figma section spec and work through how you'd model and build it. Collaborative, not Leetcode.

  • 60 min call with leadership, focused on examples of collaboration, growth, and the details of your future team.

Other important info:

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Significant experience designing and delivering data architectures for production systems, with evidence that your designs have shipped and run - not remained on paper.

  • ROI calculation: compute cost-per-engagement and conversion rates automatically for each campaign

  • Invoice processing: route creator invoices to finance systems once content is verified as live

  • Payment status alerts: send automated notifications to finance and creators when payments process

  • Build and maintain the integrations and webhook triggers that connect social platforms, CRM, finance, Slack, and e-signature tools

  • Own reliability: error handling, monitoring, secrets management, and audit trails so automations run cleanly and securely

  • Validate and troubleshoot data (SQL) and document workflows so they stay maintainable as the program scales

  • Experience integrating APIs and building webhook-driven workflows across marketing, CRM, and finance systems

  • SQL proficiency for data validation and troubleshooting

  • Systems thinking with strong attention to reliability, error handling, and clean data

  • Comfort with secrets management, authentication, and basic security and audit practices for automations

  • Clear communicator who can partner with non-technical marketing, finance, and legal stakeholders

  • You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up

title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager - Body, Closures & Chassis
description:
As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager for Body, Closures & Chassis, you will serve as the Program Lead for our Body, Closures & Chassis Systems. You will provide the overarching technical direction and leadership required to guide the vehicle program from concept through production across Body, Closures, and Chassis domains.
 
In this position, you will bridge the gap between high-level program milestones and deep technical execution. You are responsible for balancing performance attributes, cost, quality, and manufacturability while coordinating engineering execution across our internal team and external partners.

In this role, you will:
  • Serve as the program and technical lead for the vehicle program across Body (BIW, structures), Closures (doors, mechanisms, glazing), and Chassis (suspension, subframes, tires, wheels, by-wire systems), collaborating with internal engineers and external supplier design teams to ensure cohesive engineering execution.
  • Oversee BOM integrity, approve critical build processes, and drive quality and cost engineering initiatives throughout the supply chain for your major assemblies.
    Develop program schedules and partner with suppliers, quality, procurement, service, manufacturing, and engineering teams to drive complex open issues to closure and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Identify and communicate program progress, engineering challenges, and technical risks while proactively developing and leading strategic mitigation plans across the organization.
  • Lead the root-cause analysis and tracking of critical build and design issues impacting vehicle performance, quality, and production readiness to drive long-term engineering solutions.
  • Influence system designs to optimize performance, cost, quality, manufacturability, and serviceability by leading top-level design reviews, DFMEAs, validation programs, and manufacturing mock-builds.

    • Qualifications
  • B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineer, or a related technical discipline
  • 12+ years of deep automotive engineering experience, with focus on Body, Closures or Chassis design and project management.
  • Proficiency with advanced automotive engineering tools and methodologies, including CATIA V5/V6, PLM/BOM management, FMEA/FTA, and structured root-cause analysis (8D, Fishbone), and project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Polarion, Gantt charts, ERP, PLM, ALM).
  • Experience designing for attributes such as crash, NVH, reliability, strength, and corrosion.
  • A proven track record of managing complex cross-functional projects and delivering components via external design suppliers and contract manufacturers.
  • End-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) experience.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across all levels, from peers and suppliers to manufacturing and executive management.
  • Ability to travel globally as required.

    • Bonus Qualifications
  • Familiarity with hardware/firmware product development and vehicle CAN/Firmware.
